updates.reserve_cell: function(doc, req) { var body = JSON.parse(req.body); if (!doc) { doc = { _id: req.id, valeur: 1, agents: [body.agent] }; return [doc, JSON.stringify({ message: 'Cell created and reserved', doc: doc })]; } if (doc.valeur === 0) { doc.valeur += 1; doc.agents.push(body.agent); return [doc, JSON.stringify({ message: 'Cell reserved', doc: doc })]; } else { return [null, JSON.stringify({ message: 'Cell already reserved'  })]; } }
